## list

List Email Connections. `GET /email-connections`

List all email connections for the tenant.

Returns a unified view of both email_provider_configs (SendGrid, Mailgun, SES) and email_integrations (Gmail, SMTP/IMAP, Proxy).

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailConnections()->list();
```

- Scopes: `email_integrations:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$includeInactive` | `?bool` | no |  |

Returns `EmailConnectionList`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Connections/list_email_connections_api_v1_email_connections_get)

## getCampaignProvider

Get Campaign Provider. `GET /email-connections/campaign-provider`

Get the current campaign provider for the tenant.

Returns the email connection that is configured as the active campaign provider. Only one connection can be the campaign provider at a time.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailConnections()->getCampaignProvider();
```

- Scopes: `email_integrations:read`

Returns `EmailConnection`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Connections/get_campaign_provider_api_v1_email_connections_campaign_provider_get)

## unlinkOutboundProvider

Unlink Outbound Provider. `DELETE /email-connections/{connection_id}/link-outbound`

Unlink the outbound provider from a proxy integration.

After unlinking, the proxy integration will no longer be able to send replies.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailConnections()->unlinkOutboundProvider(connectionId: 'connection_id');
```

- Scopes: `email_integrations:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$connectionId` | `string` | yes |  |

## linkOutboundProvider

Link Outbound Provider. `PATCH /email-connections/{connection_id}/link-outbound`

Link an outbound provider to a proxy integration.

This allows proxy integrations (which can receive inbound emails) to send replies using a SendGrid, Mailgun, or SES provider.

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailConnections()->linkOutboundProvider(connectionId: 'connection_id', outboundProviderId: 'outbound_provider_id');
```

- Scopes: `email_integrations:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$connectionId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$outboundProviderId` | `string` | yes | ID of the email provider config to use for sending replies |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `LinkOutboundProvider`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Connections/link_outbound_provider_api_v1_email_connections__connection_id__link_outbound_patch)

## setCampaignProvider

Set Campaign Provider. `PATCH /email-connections/{connection_id}/set-campaign-provider`

Set this connection as the active campaign provider.

Only connections with can_send_campaigns=True can be set as campaign providers (SendGrid, Mailgun, SES).

```php
$result = $sendseven->emailConnections()->setCampaignProvider(connectionId: 'connection_id');
```

- Scopes: `email_integrations:update`

|---|---|---|---|
| `$connectionId` | `string` | yes |  |
